title: 第003章 灵根检测零灵气，一曲琴音震众人
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

村口空地人声鼎沸，喧闹不止。

清风宗两名外门弟子神情懒散，动作机械，日复一日重复着山下海选的枯燥工作。

对于他们这种底层外门修士而言，下山选凡人弟子，是最清闲也最无前途的杂务，根本提不起半点兴致。

他们手中各握着一块巴掌大小、通体乳白、温润通透的测灵玉牌。

这是修仙界最基础的测灵法器，凡人手掌覆上玉牌，便可引动体内灵根气息，迸发对应色彩灵光。

金、木、水、火、土五色灵光，色泽越亮、灵光越盛越纯，灵根天赋越好，修行速度越快。

若是无灵根、灵根残缺者，玉牌黯淡无光，毫无反应。

排队的少年少女一个个上前检测。

“淡青木灵光！木火土三灵根，资质平平，可入外门！”

“微弱蓝水灵光，五行杂灵根，修行缓慢，勉强收录外门！”

“五色细碎杂光、灵光虚浮！低劣杂灵根，不堪造就，不合格！”

一声声通报响起，有人欢喜有人失落。

村里大部分孩子都是微弱灵光的杂灵根，能勉强入外门一两个已是万幸。

极少数天赋稍好的，瞬间被全村人簇拥夸赞，风光无限。

蔡文龙排在队伍靠前的位置，轮到他时，他昂首挺胸，满脸自信，手掌稳稳覆在测灵玉牌之上。

下一瞬，玉牌亮起一抹颇为浓郁的青色木灵光，光亮澄澈，远超村里其余孩童。

外门弟子眼中微微泛起一丝满意。

“纯青木土双灵根！天赋上佳！直接录入内门备选，重点培养！

话音落下，全村瞬间沸腾！

“太好了！文龙出息了！”

“不愧是咱们蔡家村第一天才！”

“将来一定能修成大道，带着咱们村子腾飞！”

王桂香挤在人群最前方，笑得满脸褶皱开花，腰杆挺得笔直，得意嚣张。

她刻意回头瞥了一眼末尾孤零零站着的蔡小姬，眼神嘲讽十足，优越感爆棚。

同样是蔡家孩子，一个天，一个地！

一个是天之骄子，将来修仙得道。

一个是废柴累赘，终生贫贱！

蔡文龙享受着全村吹捧的目光，越发傲气十足，转头看向蔡小姬，语气带着施舍般的怜悯：

“看见了？这就是差距。老老实实认命做凡人，别再痴心妄想。”

周遭哄笑声再起，字字句句都在践踏少女的尊严。

蔡文姬神色始终平静，不恼不怒，不争不辩，安静等待排队。

终于，队伍渐渐走到临近末尾的蔡文姬。

全场所有人的目光，齐刷刷聚焦在她身上，等着看她出丑、看她狼狈、看她彻底被碾碎最后一点念想。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

The open space at the entrance of the village was full of people and noisy.

The two outer disciples of the Qingfeng Sect looked lazy and acted mechanically, repeating the boring work of auditioning under the mountain day after day.

For low-level outer sect monks like them, going down the mountain to choose mortal disciples is the most leisurely and most promising chore, and it doesn't arouse the slightest interest.

In each of their hands, they held a palm-sized, milky white, warm and transparent spiritual jade tablet.

This is the most basic spirit-detecting instrument in the world of immortality. When a mortal person puts his palm on the jade tablet, it can activate the breath of spiritual roots in the body and burst out the aura of the corresponding color.

Among the five colors of aura of gold, wood, water, fire, and earth, the brighter the color, the richer and purer the aura, the better the spiritual root talent, and the faster the cultivation speed.

If there is no spiritual root or the spiritual root is incomplete, the jade plaque will be dull and unresponsive.

The boys and girls in line came forward to get tested one by one.

"Light green wood spiritual light! The three spiritual roots of wood, fire and earth, with mediocre qualifications, can enter the outer gate!"

"Weak blue water spiritual light, mixed spiritual roots of the five elements, slow cultivation, barely able to absorb the outer sect!"

"Five-color scattered light, empty spiritual light! Inferior mixed spiritual roots, unworthy of cultivation, unqualified!"

Announcements were heard one after another, some were happy and some were disappointed.

Most of the children in the village are miscellaneous spiritual roots with weak spiritual light. It is lucky to have one or two who can barely enter the outer gate.

A very small number of people with slightly better talents are instantly praised by the whole village and enjoy unlimited glory.

Cai Wenlong was at the front of the queue. When it was his turn, he held his head high, his face full of confidence, and his palms resting firmly on the jade tablet.

The next moment, the jade sign lit up with a rather rich cyan wood spiritual light, which was brighter and clearer than the other children in the village.

There was a hint of satisfaction in the eyes of the outer disciples.

"Pure green wood soil double spiritual roots! Excellent talent! Directly enter the inner sect as a candidate and focus on training!

As soon as the words fell, the whole village boiled!

"Great!Wenlong is on his way!"

"He is indeed the number one genius in our Caijia Village!"

“In the future, we will definitely be able to build a highway and bring our village to take off!"

Wang Guixiang squeezed into the front of the crowd, her face wrinkled with laughter, her waist straight and arrogant.

She deliberately glanced back at Cai Xiaoji, who was standing alone at the end, her eyes full of sarcasm and her sense of superiority.

They are also children of the Cai family, living in the same sky and on the same earth!

One is a proud man of heaven who will become an immortal in the future.

One is a useless burden and will remain poor and lowly for life!

Cai Wenlong enjoyed the adulation of the whole village, and became more and more arrogant. He turned to look at Cai Xiaoji, and his tone was as compassionate as charity:

"See?This is the gap.Be honest and accept your fate as a mortal, and stop having wishful thinking."

The surrounding laughter started again, and every word was trampling on the girl's dignity.

Cai Wenji always looked calm, neither annoyed nor angry, arguing or arguing, and waited quietly in line.

Finally, the team gradually reached Cai Wenji who was near the end.

The eyes of everyone in the room were all focused on her, waiting to see her make a fool of herself, see her in embarrassment, and see her completely crushed to pieces.
